newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portucel falls on James Capel report.
newsitem.headline: Portucel falls on James Capel report.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese pulp company Portucel Industrial fell after HSBC James Capel said it was reducing its forecasts for the paper industry across the board.
At 1030 GMT the stock was steadier at 1,030 escudos, down 9 on volume of 17,200, after earlier dropping 23 escudos.
"The next support level for Portucel is at 1,000 escudos but it all depends on how the market interprets the report when we have time for a closer look," said one trader.
"The share's first reaction was to fall but we'll have to see how the big investor who has been buying Portucel heavily this week responds," said another dealer.
Capel said a recovery expected late this year and in early 1997 might not happen. Expectations of such a recovery had been boosting Portucel's price recently.
